decision.reason: [ev-0e368e6a6f71] is one changelog line, "Storage: remove signatureversionv2 from s3", that points to PR 10295 and is listed under Features. It doesn't say whether signatureversionv2 was a config key or a value of a signature-version setting. It also doesn't give the full config path, or say what happens to a configuration that still uses it: a startup or parse error, silent ignore, or a fallback to v4. To fill in the consequence we need the PR text, an upgrade-guide entry, or a config-reference diff.
